product: One line: what it is and what it does for whom.
audience: Who this run is about. One segment, not 'everyone'.
decision: What decision should this research improve? e.g. which three ad angles to test next month.

context.positioning: How the product is currently positioned, if it is.
currentMessaging: Existing headline, tagline or ad line already in use.
differentiators: Something true about this product that competitors cannot say.
competitors: Named alternative, including 'doing nothing' where that is the real one.
priorLearnings: What has already been tested and what happened.
constraints: Regulatory, brand, tone or claim constraints that rule messaging in or out.

claimConstraints: Claims this product must never make (regulated categories, unproven outcomes, comparative claims).

requested.why: Why this source is likely to carry relevant language.

limits._units: A venue is one site, community or system. A source is one URL within it.

paid.note: Free web research needs no approval. Anything with a marginal cost is proposed with an estimate and waits for an explicit yes.
